posts.text:
Saturday, Nov 14: Toronto's streetcars lost 937 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 510 Spadina northbound. A typical 5.5 km trip lost 13 min (usually 13).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch eastbound, 10 min over 7.8 km (usually 12).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Saturday's slowest spot: Southbound on Spadina Ave, approaching Queen St West.
The average streetcar lost 2 min here (usually 1 min 40 s). Across 233 trips, that adds up to 7.8 hours.
This signal has transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Spadina Ave around Queen St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the southbound stretch at Queen St West is highlighted, peaking at about 2 min lost per streetcar.

shot.title: Spadina Ave southbound, approaching Queen St West
shot.sub: Saturday, Nov 14: 2 min lost per streetcar · 233 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Saturday, Nov 14: 510 Spadina. 1 in 13 trips (40) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side (southbound, 17), instead of going on to Union Station.

Across all routes, 4% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 510 Spadina route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Queens Quay West at Lower Spadina Ave East Side, gives how many southbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Union Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Saturday, Nov 14: northbound at Spadina Ave & Front St W.

36% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle. This signal has no transit priority.
About 227 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Spadina Ave & Front St W, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the northbound approach reads 36% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Saturday, Nov 14: at the busiest moment (2:50 pm), 149 streetcars were in service, against 149 scheduled.
Overall, 99% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 928 hours on streetcar routes.
Furthest behind: 505 Dundas, at 94% of its scheduled service.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Saturday, Nov 14, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 149 streetcars at 2:50 pm, against 149 scheduled; over the day 99% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Saturday, Nov 14: Dundas St West at Howard Park Ave (506 Carlton westbound).

Riders waited 9.9 min on average, against 5.0 if cars had come as scheduled: 4.9 min extra. 22% of cars came bunched, and 10 of 121 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Dundas St West at Howard Park Ave in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 4.9 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
